summary: Lower delete of a non-reference expression by evaluating it, discarding its value, and returning true.

target.notes: For a non-Reference result, delete returns true after GetValue of the operand, so operand side effects and exceptions remain observable.

caveats: This rule must not match property references, identifiers, private fields, or optional-chain references.
Statement-level lowering may be needed for await/yield-sensitive operands.
